profile.title: Software Development Engineer
profile.subtitle: Software Engineer
profile.description: Software Development Engineer passionate about designing modern, high-performance and scalable web applications. Specialized in Full Stack development, I work primarily with Java Spring Boot, Angular, React and PostgreSQL databases. I intervene at every stage of the development cycle: requirements analysis, technical design, development, performance optimization and application deployment. Passionate about next-generation web system architecture and distributed cloud infrastructures, I design scalable, robust solutions adapted to high-load environments.

about.description: Full Stack developer passionate about clean architecture and high-performance systems.
about.desc-1: Curious and passionate about modern backend architectures, I am particularly interested in distributed systems, microservices, and solutions based on Spring Boot and Spring Cloud. I also work on event-driven architectures using Kafka, as well as optimizing communication systems and data exchange between services, especially through MCP-like approaches and advanced API design.
about.desc-2: With an innovation-driven mindset, I explore the integration of artificial intelligence into backend applications in order to design smarter, more responsive, and adaptive systems. I place particular emphasis on performance, resilience, and scalability in the architectures I design.
